detail: Song: Tom Petty, 'Love Is a Long Road' (Full Moon Fever, 1989). Gave a 2025 window. 93 million YouTube views in its first day.

item: Love Is a Long Road streaming spike
detail: Spotify streams up 36,979% on the same period a week earlier, by Spotify's own figures. No absolute counts were given.
Song: The Pointer Sisters, 'Hot Together'. Over 475 million views across platforms in its first day, Rockstar says.
Spotify streams up 182,000% in the two hours after Trailer 2 against a week earlier, by Spotify's figures.
Moved from May 26, 2026 (itself moved from a 2025 window). PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Strauss Zelnick: year 'led by the November 19th release of Grand Theft Auto VI'.

item: 14 radio station names in leaked footage
detail: Back Country Radio, The Chamber 106.6, CircoLoco Records Radio, Cocoteo FM, Dirty South Classics, Emotion 98.3, Kaleidoscope FM, La Ola, Radio ON-U, Stockyard FM, Symphony FM, The Wipe, Worldwide FM, V-Rock. Kotaku pulled the list together from leaked videos fans shared. Four were confirmed on October 8, 2026, and all 14 are in the launch-day station lists.

item: The Extended Look premieres on Netflix
detail: A preview of about 26 minutes. Reported songs include Jayda G & Aluna 'Mine O Mine', Depeche Mode 'People Are People' and Elderbrook & Bob Moses 'Inner Light'. Launch-day lists put 'People Are People' on Vice City FM and 'Mine O' Mine' on Flash FM.
source: DJ Mag, 2026-08-28, https://djmag.com/news/watch-new-gta-6-trailer-featuring-music-jayda-g-aluna-depeche-mode-more; date per Red Bull 2026-09-24

item: GTA VI: The Album announced by Rockstar and Atlantic Records
detail: 34 original tracks, out November 19, 2026. Six singles: Yung Lean feat. Future & Metro Boomin; Travis Scott 'RHYNO'; CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.., Etienne de Crecy 'Sexy Magic'; Morgan Wallen; Rauw Alejandro; Keith Richards.

item: Liquid-filled vinyl sells out per storefront
detail: The $124.98 / GBP 108.99 limited edition sold out within minutes on the UK store and on the EU store that evening; the US store still listed it at 21:30 UTC. This happened in September, not November.

item: Atlantic says album took two years
detail: The Atlantic president wrote on Instagram that the album took 'two years of our lives' with Rockstar.

item: Spotify glitch shows Cardi B and Fuerza Regida
detail: The album page briefly listed Cardi B at track 19 and Fuerza Regida at track 10, with no titles, then dropped them. Both slots match the official tracklist of November 17.

item: First six radio stations and hosts revealed
detail: Cocoteo FM (Bad Bunny, RaiNao), Back Country Radio (Morgan Wallen, Lana Del Rey, Jeremy Dufrene), AfroBank FM (Burna Boy, Palms Trax), The Chamber 106.6 (Kerry King, Tom Araya), Flash FM (Robyn, Alex Consani), Dirty South Classics (Trick Daddy, Trina). Plus on-demand podcasts.
Song: Justice 'Flower in a Hurricane' feat. Tame Impala, SZA, King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard (on The Album). Justice named composers of the original score.

Sensor Tower estimates about 7.71 million digital pre-orders worth about $751 million, 74% on PS5 and 26% on Xbox, and projects up to 25 million and about $2B by launch. An outside estimate, digital only, not company data.
source: GGRecon, 2026-11-05, https://www.ggrecon.com/articles/gta-6-pre-orders-sensor-tower/; $2B projection per The Express Tribune 2026-11-10

detail: November 19 release reiterated; Zelnick says pre-orders at 'unprecedented levels'. FY2027 net bookings guidance $8.0B-$8.2B. No unit figures.

A photo said to show the back of a vinyl edition, shared on X. It adds Playboi Carti, Dua Lipa, Young Thug, Cardi B, JENNIE, Zara Larsson, Camila Cabello, Lana Del Rey (as artist) and others. Rockstar published the same 34 tracks three days later.

item: Viral post on album artists and vinyl
detail: Mixes official facts (Rockstar/Atlantic, 34 songs, Travis Scott, Future, Tame Impala, SZA) with leak-only names (Dua Lipa, Carti, JENNIE, Cardi B, Cabello, Larsson, Young Thug) and passes off the September vinyl sellout as new. Every name in it was on the official tracklist two days later.
source: Cross-check of MBW 2026-09-17, Stereogum 2026-10-15, Omelete, GTA Intel 2026-09-17

item: GTA VI and The Album released
detail: Game on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S; the 34-track album on streaming the same day. Vinyl and CD ship November 20.

Grand Theft Auto VI: Original Score, by Justice: 30 tracks plus digital bonus tracks, on streaming, CD and vinyl, due December 11, 2026. New single 'Pusher' features Gesaffelstein. Rockstar calls the score adaptive.

Rockstar released the full tracklist, opening with Justice feat. Michael McDonald 'Starting from Zero' and closing with Stanley Clarke, Yussef Dayes and Robert Glasper 'Overtown Lights'. It matches the list that leaked on November 14.
A clip released by Brazilian outlet VOXL shows Ask Dr. Nita, an advice show on talk station The Wipe, voiced by Anitta with Barbie Ferreira as a guest.

Press lists on launch day count 22 stations: 20 music and two talk (WKTT and The Wipe). KeenGamer logs 249 songs; GameRant lists more on several stations. The fan-run GTA Wiki lists 48 more that neither has. Rockstar has not published full playlists.
F*ck, Marry, Murder; The Safe Trip; Vice City True Stories; Drunk Kings; Final Act. A few are unlocked from the start and more episodes open as the story goes on.

item: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival
detail: At Mana Wynwood, Miami. Complex lists Travis Scott, Kodak Black, Cardi B, Don Toliver and Justice as performers; tickets went by lottery.
Justice's 30-track score album, three weeks after the game.
